interpretation.motion_counts: frame-wise observations, not unique objects; visual-only also tracks motion but does not remove geometric residuals
interpretation.visual_counts: mask activation, not a dense 2D segmentation score or direct count of removed residuals; accepted rows include IEKF iterations
interpretation.likelihood_counts: final-iteration rows of each update, not statistically independent observations
interpretation.accuracy: not scored; one development repetition with cached labels supports mechanism activation only
interpretation.online: not validated; replay is 0.125x on a temporary GitHub CPU runner
interpretation.motion_quality: false positives/negatives not quantified by this replay
interpretation.loop_closure: off; non-rigid map rebuilding not validated
interpretation.next_step: separately freeze a bounded paired accuracy evaluation with repeated runs before considering a large experiment
interpretation.unlogged_visual_updates: visual_updates and accepted row counters are emitted only when semantic visual masking is enabled; zero in other arms does not mean VIO did not run
interpretation.recomputed_order: diagnostic only; disagreements are preserved. Annotation uses carried original raw_point_index checked against exact message xyz/intensity, never recomputed sort order
